CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_is_order_candidate_rider(p_order_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.rider_assignments ra
        INNER JOIN public.riders r ON r.id = ra.rider_id
        WHERE ra.order_id = p_order_id AND r.user_id = p_user_id
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.admins
    WHERE email = auth.email() AND is_active = true
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rider_is_on_active_trip(p_rider_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.orders o
        WHERE o.rider_id = p_rider_id
          AND (
                o.order_status::text IN ('rider_arrived', 'picked_up', 'rider_at_drop', 'ongoing', 'payment_pending')
                OR (
                    o.order_status::text = 'accepted'
                    AND (
                        public.get_required_service_mode(o.order_type::text, o.distance_meters) = 'local'
                        OR o.trip_started_at IS NOT NULL
                    )
                )
              )
    );
$function$

indexes.name: idx_riders_kyc_id
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_riders_kyc_id ON public.riders USING btree (kyc_id)

indexes.name: idx_riders_subscription_active
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_riders_subscription_active ON public.riders USING btree (subscription_active)

indexes.name: idx_riders_account_status
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_riders_account_status ON public.riders USING btree (account_status)

indexes.name: idx_riders_government_tax_due_balance
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_riders_government_tax_due_balance ON public.riders USING btree (government_tax_due_balance)

indexes.name: idx_riders_service_mode
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_riders_service_mode ON public.riders USING btree (service_mode) WHERE (account_status = 'online'::rider_account_status_enum)

indexes.name: idx_riders_location_updated
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_riders_location_updated ON public.riders USING btree (last_location_updated_at DESC)

indexes.name: idx_riders_created_at
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_riders_created_at ON public.riders USING btree (created_at DESC)

indexes.name: idx_riders_online_coords
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_riders_online_coords ON public.riders USING btree (current_lat, current_lng) WHERE (account_status = 'online'::rider_account_status_enum)

indexes.name: users_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_pkey ON public.users USING btree (id)

indexes.name: users_phone_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_phone_key ON public.users USING btree (phone)

indexes.name: users_user_code_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_user_code_key ON public.users USING btree (user_code)

triggers.name: trg_rider_locations_near_destination_check
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_rider_locations_near_destination_check AFTER UPDATE OF current_lat, current_lng ON rider_locations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION check_rider_near_destination_from_rider_locations()

triggers.name: on_rider_status_change
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER on_rider_status_change AFTER UPDATE OF account_status ON riders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_rider_status_change()

triggers.name: protect_rider_financial_columns_trigger
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER protect_rider_financial_columns_trigger BEFORE UPDATE ON riders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_rider_financial_columns()

triggers.name: trg_riders_gps_bridge_to_rider_locations
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_riders_gps_bridge_to_rider_locations AFTER UPDATE OF current_lat, current_lng ON riders FOR EACH ROW WHEN (old.current_lat IS DISTINCT FROM new.current_lat OR old.current_lng IS DISTINCT FROM new.current_lng OR old.current_heading IS DISTINCT FROM new.current_heading OR old.last_location_updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM new.last_location_updated_at OR old.last_active_at IS DISTINCT FROM new.last_active_at) EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_riders_gps_to_rider_locations()

triggers.name: trigger_assign_nearby_orders
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_assign_nearby_orders AFTER UPDATE OF account_status ON riders FOR EACH ROW WHEN (new.account_status = 'online'::rider_account_status_enum AND old.account_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'online'::rider_account_status_enum) EXECUTE FUNCTION assign_nearby_searching_orders_to_rider()

triggers.name: trigger_prevent_service_mode_switch_during_active_order
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_prevent_service_mode_switch_during_active_order BEFORE UPDATE OF service_mode ON riders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_service_mode_switch_during_active_order()

triggers.name: trigger_rider_wallet_balance_update
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_rider_wallet_balance_update AFTER UPDATE OF wallet_balance ON riders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION on_rider_wallet_balance_update()
